import_dir.ask: Folder watched for sample-table batch files (on the Compass PC, or a share of it)
import_dir.help: The package writes one mhp_<job>.csv per run here (Sample, Position, Method, Injection). A helper script, or the person at the Compass PC, imports it into a batch and starts the run.

results_dir.ask: Folder where Compass's peak-table CSV exports land
results_dir.help: Export the run's peak table as CSV into this folder; the sample names carry the mhp_<job> token, so the file name is free but the token in it helps.

software.ask: Compass for iCE version on the instrument PC (for the record)

allowed_methods.ask: Compass method names an agent may queue (JSON list; empty allows any)

result_wait_s.ask: Seconds to wait for the peak-table export before the job fails

poll_s.ask: Seconds between looks at the results folder
